name: Evin Lewis
profileSummary: Evin Earl Lewis is a Trinidadian cricketer who plays for the West Indies as a left-handed opening batsman in limited-overs internationals. Lewis is the third batsman, after Brendon McCullum and Chris Gayle, to score two Twenty20 International centuries. Lewis also holds the records of the highest retired hurt score, of 176 not out, in international cricket along with the highest score, of 125 not out, by a West Indian in T20 internationals. Lewis was a member of the West Indies team that won the 2016 T20 World Cup.
